mainEntity.name: How much does a Range Rover SDV6 Hybrid engine replacement cost?

acceptedAnswer.text: A full rebuilt Range Rover SDV6 Hybrid engine typically costs between £7,500 and £11,000 for supply only. Reconditioned units start around £6,500, while used engines can be found from £3,500. Prices vary based on whether you choose supply-only or a full supply and fit service.

mainEntity.name: What are the signs of crankshaft bearing failure in a Range Rover SDV6 Hybrid?

acceptedAnswer.text: Early warning signs include a distinct metallic knocking or rumbling noise from the bottom of the engine, particularly during cold starts or under heavy load. You might also experience fluctuating oil pressure warnings on the dashboard or metallic flakes in the engine oil.

mainEntity.name: Is it worth replacing the engine in a Range Rover SDV6 Hybrid?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, given the current premium vehicle market. A well-maintained Range Rover SDV6 Hybrid (L405) holds a value of £14,000 to £55,000+. Investing £7,500-£11,000 in a rebuilt engine with a 12-month warranty is financially viable and protects the appreciating asset value of this flagship luxury SUV.

mainEntity.name: How does the hybrid system affect a Range Rover SDV6 Hybrid engine replacement?

acceptedAnswer.text: The 306DT engine in the Range Rover SDV6 Hybrid is mated to an integrated electric motor within the ZF 8-speed gearbox housing. Replacing the engine requires specialist high-voltage safety protocols and precise software recalibration to ensure the diesel block and electric motor communicate correctly with the ECU.

mainEntity.name: How long does a Range Rover SDV6 Hybrid engine replacement take?

acceptedAnswer.text: A professional supply and fit service for a Range Rover SDV6 Hybrid typically takes 3 to 5 working days due to the complexity of the V8/V6 installation, hybrid system integration, and ancillary components. This includes removal, thorough cleaning, installation, and comprehensive software calibration.

historyTimeline.h2: Range Rover SDV6 Hybrid - Engine History & Specs at a Glance
historyTimeline.intro: Launched in 2013 for the L405 generation, the Range Rover SDV6 Hybrid combined the torque-rich 3.0-litre V6 diesel with an integrated electric motor, delivering flagship performance and improved efficiency for the luxury SUV segment.

milestones.description: 306DT (Hybrid Configuration) introduced, 3.0L Diesel + Electric Motor, 335hp combined (Brought parallel hybrid technology to the Range Rover diesel lineup, utilizing a ZF 8-speed integrated electric module).
Updated engine mapping and revised cooling system components introduced to manage the combined thermal loads of the V6 diesel and hybrid battery system.
Final model year for the Range Rover SDV6 Hybrid, preceding the industry-wide shift to the P400e petrol PHEV and inline-6 Ingenium mild-hybrid architectures.

commonProblems.h3: The Range Rover SDV6 Hybrid utilises the complex 3.0-litre V6 diesel (306DT) paired with a high-voltage hybrid module. While capable, the diesel block has documented vulnerabilities requiring specialist attention. problems.h4: Crankshaft Bearing & Oil Pump Failure - Why the Range Rover SDV6 Hybrid 306DT Wears Prematurely
problems.rootCause: The tin-aluminium coating on the crankshaft bearings is prone to fatigue and flaking, leading to oil pressure drops, bottom-end knock, and catastrophic engine seizure if the oil pump also suffers from contamination.

repairOptions.whatItInvolves: Oil analysis, oil pump inspection, and turbo cleaning
repairOptions.longevity: Suitable only for early-stage prevention; ineffective once bearing knock is present

repairOptions.whatItInvolves: Supply & fit, upgraded crankshaft bearings, revised oil pump, hybrid module integration, 12-month warranty
repairOptions.longevity: The definitive solution for bottom-end knock, oil pressure warnings, or catastrophic failure

Given the premium flagship valuation of the L405, a rebuilt or reconditioned engine is a financially sound investment that protects the vehicle's strong retained asset value.
